rules.name: Initiative Training
rules.description: If an infantry squad's NCO is killed then roll a D6. On the score of a 1, 2, or 3 the NCO is removed as normal. On the roll of a 4, 5, or 6 one of the troopers takes over the squad and leads it just as effectively as before. To represent this, leave the NCO in place and remove any other model instead. If the NCO is successfully replaced the unit does not suffer the usual -1 morale penalty for losing its NCO.

rules.name: Hitler's Buzzsaw
rules.description: German infantry units equipped with light and medium machine guns fire one extra shot (5 for LMG and 6 for a MMG). This includes weapons mounted on vehicles.

rules.name: Fatherland Resurgent
rules.description: German infantry units, larger than 5 models, may ignore the negative modifier of one pinning marker when taking Advance order tests. They still have to take a test if they only have a single pin marker, but do not suffer the -1 to their morale for the first marker.
